title: Sales Manager - ESS Fire Protection Systems - APAC - KOREA
description:
Our client is a global leader in fire protection, specializing in both fire detection and suppression systems for commercial, industrial, and high-risk environments. Their solutions are designed to protect life, property, and business continuity by combining early-warning detection with rapid, effective fire response.
On the detection side, they manufacture advanced smoke, heat, and multi-sensor detectors connected to intelligent control panels that provide real-time monitoring, alarms, and automated safety responses. This ensures fires are identified at the earliest possible stage, allowing prompt action to minimise damage.
For suppression, they offer versatile mechanical systems, including sprinklers, pumps, and flow-switches. These are tailored to specific risks and integrate seamlessly with detection systems, ensuring coordinated and efficient fire mitigation.
Renowned for reliability, innovation, and compliance with international standards, they deliver complete, configurable fire safety solutions trusted by businesses worldwide.
Job Purpose
The Sales Manager of Energy Storage Fire Systems (ESS) APAC is responsible for developing and executing fire alarm systems selling to energy storage industry across Asia, excluding China (where they have separate dedicated support). The successful candidate will work closely with key business partners, marketing, manufacturing, customer service, and the senior management team to maximize growth, development and return on investment of the business today and in the future.
The sales approach begins by identifying customer demands before they become challenges. Our client committed to delivering customer success through their comprehensive expertise in fire alarm and releasing control. Manage all aspects of engagements with existing and new customers for their fire alarm systems organization. You will build relationships and understand customer business to provide appropriate products or solutions. You will define sales and growth strategy toward key customers while aligning with critical sales business objectives. You will identify opportunities and build credibility with customers and utilize your product knowledge to deliver the value proposition to the customers.

• Support products and customers

• Utilize CRM SalesForce

• Provide technical support

• Assist with applications & solutions

• Identify opportunities and manage momentum through the sales cycle

• Articulate and deliver Potter value proposition

• Manage and plan accounts

• Negotiate and close

• Establish rapport with customers

• Fluency in an Asian language and English is essential.

• Strong interpersonal skills, acting with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation abilities

• Effective time management and organisational skills, with the ability to meet deadlines

• Analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to prioritise and delegate tasks appropriately

• Understanding of B2B sales, distribution networks, and regional business practices

• Strong listening skills and the ability to quickly identify customer needs

• Ability to work independently and travel extensively across Asia.

• Proven experience in sales management, preferably in international or European markets

Required Qualifications

• Minimum of 8 years experience in sales, ideally within fire protection, life safety, or industrial sectors

description:

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

 

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

 

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Шукаємо Creative Marketing Manager в команду, де разом піднімаємо планку результатів. Якщо ти зараз працюєш в Marketing Designer і хочеш перейти в креативний маркетинг, відгукуйся, такі профілі ми теж розглядаємо.

ЩО РОБИТЬ ЦЮ РОЛЬ ОСОБЛИВОЮ

- Масштаб тестування: гіпотези запускаються системно на широкому міксі каналів.

- Рутина автоматизована: автобриф для постановки задач, шаблони і готова структура для варіацій, AI-стек для текстовок і ресерчу. Свої автоматизації можна викатити на всю команду.

- Команда топових експертів ринку: User Acquisition, дизайн, MarTech та аналітика працюють пліч-о-пліч, і прямі партнерства з Meta і Google.

- Два треки розвитку: поглиблення експертизи до Senior Creative Marketer або перехід у лідерську роль Creative Lead.

ВИКЛИКИ, ЯКІ ЧЕКАЮТЬ НА ЦІЙ РОЛІ

- Досліджувати ринок і конкурентів через спай-тули (Meta Ad Library, Adheart і тп) та формувати на основі цього креативні гіпотези.

- Оформлювати гіпотези у ТЗ для дизайнерів і писати текстовки: хедлайни, дескрипшени, UGC-сценарії.

- Запускати тести разом з User Acquisition менеджерами, аналізувати результати і робити висновки для наступної ітерації.

- Масштабувати креативи, що показали результат, і створювати частину креативів самостійно за допомогою автоматизації і шаблонів.

ЩО ДЛЯ НАС ВАЖЛИВО

- 2+ роки досвіду у перформанс-маркетингу, зокрема повний цикл роботи з дизайнером - від постановки ТЗ і запуску до відповідальності за результат.

- Досвід роботи зі спай-тулами та аналізу конкурентів, інтерес до автоматизації процесів.

- Робота з метриками: вмієш аналізувати результати тестів та аргументувати рішення даними.

- Буде плюсом: базові навички Figma / Adobe, робота з рекламними кабінетами Meta / Google, англійська для написання текстовок.

ЩО ТИ ОТРИМАЄШ ДОДАТКОВО РАЗОМ З НАМИ

- Внутрішні клуби за професійними напрямками: аналітика, продукт, маркетинг, розробка, фінанси і рекрутинг.

- Тренінги, курси, відвідування конференцій.

- Світлі та сучасні офіси в Києві й Варшаві, а також можливість повністю працювати віддалено.

- Медичне страхування, корпоративний лікар.

 

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.sk

We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

The Retention & Recovery Lead owns one pipeline that follows every merchant from the first sign they might leave, through retention, a well-run exit and collections, to write-off or debt sale.

Today we treat churn and collections as separate problems, and neither has a clear owner. In practice they are usually the same merchant at different points in time: a merchant who goes quiet in March becomes, by June, an unpaid fee, a terminal still in the field and a balance nobody is chasing. Collections activity also sits in pockets across the business, from unpaid subscriptions and fees, negative balances and chargebacks to terminal recovery, dissolved companies and fraud losses. As our credit products grow, so will the need.

You’ll bring all of this together under one strategy, one queue and one set of metrics. The Teams

Live UI
The Discovery and Viewing Experience (DVX) Live team owns the UI engineering and architecture that powers Live viewing experiences across TV, iOS, and Android. Members show up for live events once, with no second airing and no patch mid-show, so every feature we build is a promise that it will work at that moment on every device that tunes in. As our senior SDET, you’ll lead the way we test Live: recreating the moments a live event creates, like a vote opening just as an ad ends, long before the event does, so we know we’re ready instead of finding out during the show.

• The FIFA Women's World Cup, coming to Netflix in 2027 and 2031, will feature new experiences built for global, multi-match sport tournaments.

• Interactive and navigational features that help members move through a live event and catch the moments that matter.

• Real-time voting, which lets members influence a live show as it unfolds, alongside millions of others watching at the same moment.

Mobile Core
The DVX Mobile Core team develops and advances the architecture of Netflix 's Android member app. We leverage systems and infrastructure widely available at Netflix and determine the best way to adopt and apply them on Android, enabling easier, more efficient patterns for downstream product engineering teams.

What we’re working on :

• Modernizing our app architecture for the iOS and Android member app. This involves driving migrations and a cross-platform Player rewrite, creating leverage for product teams to ship faster and more reliably on iOS and Android.

• Driving Quality of Experience (QoE). Owning monitoring and performance improvements across Player UI and canvases, as we scale.

The Role

Problem you’ll help solve:

• Testing and making sure millions of members see our Live-specific UI features and capabilities at the right moment, on every TV and phone.

• Giving every platform the same test plan, so TV, iOS, and Android are consistently validated the same way.

• Making tests reliable enough that PMs, designers, engineers, and our partners trust them, and fast enough to run on every change.

• Keeping quality steady while the iOS and Android apps modernize, including a cross-platform player rewrite, so faster delivery doesn’t come with more regressions.

What you’ll do:

•
Lead testing for complex features across platforms. Agree on one test plan per feature that teams can trust and validate together, and implement it on TV, iOS, and Android, rather than reconciling differences afterward.

•
Build automation that people trust. Evolve our test systems and CI integration across platforms so tests are fast and reliable.

•
Make tricky live moments easy to test. Build ways to recreate them on demand instead of waiting for a real event, using mocks, overrides, real devices, and test data that looks like a real event and doesn’t expire.

•
Make large migrations safe. Build the test strategy that lets the iOS and Android apps modernize without regressions reaching members

•
Own quality metrics. Track how well we’re covered, how reliable our tests are, and which bugs reach members, and use that to decide what to improve next. That includes the client metrics that reveal problems only scale shows, and the alerts that tell us about them quickly.
